method: Analogue-computer form: node voltages carry mechanical state, so SPICE integrates the same shot ODE with a different integrator (trapezoidal) than motor_model.py's forward Euler at dt=1e-4. The electrical side is a real circuit: 6 F bank, 96 V, series ESR, load drawing P/V at the terminal.
esr_source: 12 mohm appears only in docs/EMOCD_Computation_Results_C1-C10.md, which is SUPERSEDED. No current script defines a bank ESR.

findings.finding: motor_model.py reports capacitor state-of-charge sag (4.88 %), not the terminal voltage the drive sees. With 12 mohm ESR the terminal droops to 86.16 V at end of stroke -- a 10.25 % total sag, more than double the quoted figure. The servo headroom argument behind the 0.027 m/s dispersion claim is stated against the smaller number.

Integral of I^2 dt over the shot is 8008 A^2 s. At 12 mohm that is 96 J of ESR loss, against the Q_esr = 160 J default in sizing.py thermal_campaign(). The two are consistent only if the real ESR is about 20 mohm. E17 flagged that 160 J had no second number against it; this is the second number.

verdict: pass -- all five declared bands met; two findings raised, neither falsifies a headline number
